msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

That’s a great plan! Since you’ve completed the theory and pool sessions, the *2-day Open Water Referral Course* is the right option. The refresher is booked as the *Dive Mini Course*; it’s a separate introductory activity and doesn’t count toward your certification.

The online prices include the 10% website discount. I can’t add up the group total here. The refresher includes pool practice and one ocean dive, and the referral course includes four certification dives. You’ll need to stay overnight on the islands during the referral course; accommodation isn’t included. Please also allow at least *18 hours after diving before flying*.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?
reply:
Yes! For the most convenient access to diving, I recommend *Hotel San Pedro de Majagua* or *Hotel Cocoliso* on Isla Grande—our dive base is at both, and pick-up is direct. Other nearby hotels with maritime access include Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao; pick-up arrangements depend on the hotel’s boat access. Accommodation isn’t included, so you’ll book directly with the hotel.

For the refresher and courses, a medical form is required and is sent after booking. For the Open Water Referral Course, you’ll also need the PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; it’s the referral course, not a regular dive outing.

Would you like me to help you compare the Cartagena-departure and island-based options once you’ve chosen your dates?

Where would you be departing from? This plan takes several days and you need to *stay on the islands* (accommodation is not included): you can leave *from Cartagena* on the first day or, if you're already *on the islands*, we arrange pickup at your hotel.

msg: Great. We will book diving with you on the website and will book our hotel on the island . Hope you are operating on Easter Sunday? We want to dive on April 5 and 6. How do we book/pay for the $50 refresher course?
reply:
Yes, we operate every day of the year except December 25 and January 1, so Easter Sunday is normally an operating day. Trips can be suspended if weather conditions are unsafe. The booking calendar will let you choose April 5 and 6.

Just a quick clarification: the refresher isn’t $50. Since you’ll be staying on the islands, it’s booked as the *Dive Mini Course (already on the islands)* and costs *USD 134 per person online*. It includes pool practice and one ocean dive; lunch isn’t included. You can book and pay on the website here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

For the *Open Water Referral Course*, please use the referral-course booking option on the website and select your dates and number of people there. The refresher is a separate activity, so choose its date separately. Would you like me to share the referral-course details too?

Which hotel or island are you staying at? That way we can arrange pickup.
